name: Alella

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A small Catalan DO on the Mediterranean coast just north of Barcelona, in the Maresme and Vallès Oriental. Urban growth has shrunk it to a third. Allowed grapes include whites such as Xarello, Macabeo and Garnacha Blanca, plus several reds.
